goal: Add PATCH /todos/:id endpoint to update a todo item title and/or completed status.
scope_summary: Add an update method to the store that accepts partial fields (title, completed) and refreshes updatedAt. Add a PATCH route in the todos router that looks up the item, returns 404 if missing, otherwise delegates to store.update and returns the updated item with 200. Add two tests matching the required names.
planned_changes: Add store update(id, fields) method in src/store.ts that merges partial updates and sets updatedAt to now
Add PATCH /:id route in src/routes/todos.ts that validates the item exists, calls store.update, returns 200 or 404
Add describe block in tests/todos.test.ts with two tests for update success and 404
acceptance_checks: PATCH /todos/:id updates title and/or completed and returns 200 with updated item
updatedAt changes when an update succeeds
PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error for unknown id
Unit test: todos.test.ts > PATCH /todos/:id updates the item verifies update
Unit test: todos.test.ts > PATCH /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id verifies not-found
commit_message: feat(F006): add PATCH /todos/:id endpoint with tests
risks: Store has no update method yet — must be added without breaking existing consumers
Partial update must handle sending only title, only completed, or both without clearing the other field
updatedAt assertion in tests may be flaky if compared by equality — test should verify it changed, not match an exact value
